dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a smooth concave curvature with an increasing derivative as it approaches the basal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a small pixel radius, transitioning smoothly from leading to trailing edges.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear leading edge rising at a steep acute angle relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum vertical height is approximately 0.85 times the longitudinal base width.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, large-radius convex curvature from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and thick rostrum with a low length-to-thickness ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse inflection where the anterior melon slope meets the dorsal rostrum line.

other_distinctive_markers: Monochromatic cyan translucency across the entire subject with visible internal light scattering and lack of biological surface texture.
